item.title: Black Mango 2.0.0-beta.7 for Windows
item.description:
Black Mango 2.0, test build 7

New: make your own skins

  • Skins now has its own page: Settings > Skins.
  • Make your own: start from the skin you're using or from Black Mango, then pick colors. The whole app changes as you go, and nothing is kept until you save.
  • Simple asks for three colors (background, panels and accent) and works out the rest. Advanced lets you set all of them, including the player buttons.
  • Pick colors with a color wheel, by typing a hex code, or from the built-in skins' colors.
  • Pick from screen: an eyedropper that takes a color from anything on your screen, even outside Black Mango.
  • Skin from a picture: choose a picture and Black Mango suggests a skin in its colors. Then click the picture to take any color from it.
  • Textures: grain, carbon fiber, brushed metal or paper, or your own picture. Give each area its own: the background, the top bar and sidebar, cards, search boxes, and highlights. Set each one's strength, size and tint. Your own picture can fill an area like a wallpaper or repeat as a pattern.
  • If some text would be hard to read, Black Mango tells you when you save. You can go back, keep your colors, or let it fix just those colors.
  • Add the Halloween extras to any skin: decorations, the dripping title font and the jack-o'-lantern logo.
  • My skins keeps as many as you like. Share one as a skin code to paste anywhere, or as a skin file (the file includes your own picture; a code can't fit one). Paste a code or import a file to add someone else's. Pasting a skin code into Add Account works too.

New: holiday skin drops

  • Open Black Mango during a holiday and you collect that holiday's skin pack, yours for good. A gift box opens to show it off.
  • Thanksgiving (November 1 through Thanksgiving Day): Harvest, Autumn Leaves, and Cranberry & Gold, with a mango turkey, leaves drifting down, a harvest of pumpkins and pie in the top bar, and a turkey who says Gobble! when you add an account.
  • Christmas (the day after Thanksgiving through December 25): Classic Christmas, Snowy Night, and Candy Cane, with the mango in a Santa hat holding a candy cane, snow falling, twinkling lights along the top, a snowman, an elf and a reindeer, frosty corners, and a present that pops open when you add an account.
  • Collected skins live in My skins with a star. They can't be shared as a code or file, but you can make a copy in their colors to edit.
  • Watch for surprise drops, and giveaway codes: type one in Settings > Skins > Redeem a code.

Safer

  • The video player never hands links to other programs like yt-dlp.
  • The behind-the-scenes relay that plays live channels now only answers the player on your own computer.
  • Open in VLC only passes real stream links.
  • Settings > App updates has a switch for automatic update checks. Updates are always signed, and you always choose whether to install.
  • Each release now lists every file's checksum, and GitHub can confirm the files were built from the public code. See SECURITY.md in the repository.

Fixed

  • Mouse users: category strips in Live TV, Movies and Shows have a scrollbar, and the mouse wheel slides them. Rows on Home have a scrollbar too, and the wheel slides a row while you're over its scrollbar.
  • The floating player no longer squeezes Live TV's guide into a tiny window behind it.

item.title: Black Mango 2.0.0-beta.6 for Windows
item.description:
Black Mango 2.0, test build 6

New: skins

  • Settings > Appearance has a new Skin picker. The whole app changes colors right away.
  • The Halloween pack: Pumpkin Patch, Witching Hour, Blood Moon and Graveyard Fog. Each comes with a jack-o'-lantern mango, two flickering pumpkins and some bats in the top bar, cobwebs in the corners, a little fog, dripping titles, and a ghost who says Boo! when you add an account.
  • Black Mango's own look is still the default skin, and you can switch back any time.

Fixed

  • Live TV, Movies and Shows keep your place in the list when the player floats or the window changes size. Only your own scrolling moves it.
  • New Top and Bottom buttons on those lists, plus shortcuts: Home (top), End (bottom), and B to jump back to where you were.

item.title: Black Mango 2.0.0-beta.5 for Windows
item.description:
Black Mango 2.0, test build 5

New in this build

Steadier live channels when a provider keeps dropping the connection:

  • No blocky picture after a reconnect. When the stream comes back from a different server, or with footage missing, Black Mango holds the last clean picture (the sound keeps going) until the next full frame.
  • Black Mango tries to reconnect to the same stream server first, and stops trying once a provider shows it never allows that, so reconnects are quicker.
  • Channels that keep dropping can build up to 30 seconds of cushion. It only grows when the channel actually stalls.
  • If the provider offers HLS, a jumpy channel switches to it on the same account and remembers that. If HLS doesn't show a picture within 12 seconds, Black Mango goes straight back.
  • If a channel keeps jumping, a note tells you, and Black Mango switches to the same channel on another of your accounts when one has it.
  • Settings > Fixes for flaky channels shows how many channels have extra cushion or HLS, and resets them all.

Also included (from test build 4)

  • Stalker accounts on Windows send your real time zone, so guide times line up.

item.title: Black Mango 2.0.0-beta.3 for Windows
item.description:
Black Mango 2.0, test build 3

New

  • Windows. The first Windows test build. Download the Setup .exe: it installs just for you (no admin password), adds Black Mango to the Start menu, can add a desktop shortcut, and keeps itself up to date like the Mac version.
  • Open in VLC works on Windows too.

Good to know

  • To bring your accounts, favorites and history over from a Mac, use Settings > Data > Export backup there and Import backup on Windows.

item.title: Black Mango 2.0.0-beta.2
item.description:
Black Mango 2.0, test build 2

Fixed

  • The Mac app opens normally now. Test build 1 could say it was "damaged"; that came from how the app was signed, not from the download.
  • Channels that are really a looping video file play smoothly instead of reconnecting over and over.
  • Channels whose guide comes back empty no longer fill the log with errors.
  • The Accounts screen's buttons wrap neatly when the window shrinks to the floating player.

item.title: Black Mango 2.0.0-beta.1
item.description:
Black Mango 2.0, test build 1

The first test build of the new Black Mango, rebuilt from the ground up on a faster video engine.

What's in it

  • Live TV, Movies and Shows from Xtream, M3U, and Stalker (MAG) portal accounts
  • Smart paste: paste your provider's message and the account fills itself in
  • Failover: if a channel, movie or episode won't play, it switches to the same one on another of your accounts
  • Smoother live TV: seamless reconnects, extra buffer for channels that stutter, and quick switching away from dead channels
  • A mini player that floats over other apps, with a slim minimized bar
  • Clean titles and channel names, with small quality and language tags
  • Remembers your audio and subtitle choices for each show
  • Backup and restore for accounts, favorites, history and settings
  • Automatic updates

Good to know

  • Mac only for now. Windows is coming.
  • This is a test build. If something misbehaves, send the log from Settings > Debug Log > Copy recent.
